en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobbled town square bordered by 3‑ to 4‑story buildings with shops on the ground floor. The façades carry German‑language signs such as "Johann Kayser," "Sattlerei von Otto Richter," "Buchdruckerei," and on the right "Bruno Tetzner." A few people stand in the open square; a lamppost rises near the center. In the background to the left a church roof and tower with a cross are partly visible. The scene has an early‑20th‑century Central European appearance.
